description: Shuffle the answer positions for the AI exam paper across its THREE representations so they stay mutually consistent: AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html, AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md, and AI_Exam_Model_Answer_Key.md. The correct answer identity must be preserved exactly; only its position among options changes, labels are re-lettered, and the answer key is updated to the new positions. Depends on the audit-map produced in FEAT-001.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/task-shuffle-answer-options/audit-map.md for the planned new positions of the AI paper.

AI MCQ (Q1-Q10): the correct-answer TEXTS are currently at A,B,A,A,A,A,A,D,B,A. For each question in AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html (
with
LABEL) text
), reorder the four opt-item divs so the correct answer lands at its planned new position, then re-letter all four labels A) B) C) D) to match the new physical order. Keep the and Marathi/English text of each option intact. Target a spread like Q1->C, Q2->A, Q3->D, Q4->B, Q5->C, Q6->D, Q7->B, Q8->A, Q9->C, Q10->D (or any per-audit-map spread that is roughly even across A/B/C/D and not a guessable pattern).

Apply the IDENTICAL reordering and re-lettering to the same 10 MCQs in AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md, where options are markdown checkboxes '- [ ] **A)** text'. The option order and letters MUST match the HTML exactly for the same question.

AI Fill-in (Q11-Q15): correct answers currently A,A,B,A,A. In AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html these are 4-option opt-item lists using [A]/[B]/[C]/[D]; reorder and re-letter so the correct answer moves to its planned position, spread across [A]-[D]. In AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md the same questions render options inline as '[ A) ... | B) ... | C) ... | D) ... ]'; apply the identical order and letters.

AI Match (Section D): currently column B order gives answer code 1->C,2->A,3->B,4->D (already not straight-line). Re-order column B rows in BOTH AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html (<table class='match-table'>) and AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md (Column B table) to a new ordering, re-letter the B-column labels A./B./C./D. sequentially by new physical order, and keep each column-A item mapped to its correct target by MEANING. Ensure the resulting answer code is not the straight-line 1->A,2->B,3->C,4->D.

Update AI_Exam_Model_Answer_Key.md to reflect ALL new positions: the MCQ table 'बरोबर पर्याय' column (Q1-Q10) new letters; the fill-in list Q11-Q15 new letters (and update the 'A) AI', 'A) Input' style prefixes so the letter shown matches the new option position); and the Match section 'उत्तर की (Answer Code)' plus the inline column-B letters so 1/2/3/4 map to the new letters. The correct answer TEXT in the key must stay identical; only the letter changes.

Do NOT touch AI paper sections C (True/False), E, F short-answer / reasoning parts that have no shufflable options (Q30(i) is a single-answer application MCQ whose key says A; if shuffling it, update Q30 in HTML, MD, and the answer key together; otherwise leave it and note why in findings).
Record in the feature 'findings' a per-question summary for the AI paper: old position -> new position for Q1-Q15 and the match code, plus the resulting A/B/C/D distribution.
acceptance_criteria: For every AI MCQ Q1-Q10 and fill-in Q11-Q15, the correct-answer TEXT recorded in FEAT-001 still appears exactly once and its letter in AI_Exam_Model_Answer_Key.md equals its physical position in both AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html and AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md.
Option labels in every AI options block are sequential (A,B,C,D or [A]..[D] / [A]..[C]) with no gaps or duplicates, in both HTML and MD.
The Match Section D column-B ordering and answer code are identical between AI HTML, AI MD, and the answer key, and the code is not 1->A,2->B,3->C,4->D.
Across Q1-Q15 the correct answers are spread over multiple positions (not predominantly A) and follow no trivially guessable repeating pattern.
All Marathi/English option text, CSS classes, and surrounding markup are byte-for-byte unchanged except for reordering, re-lettering, and answer-key letters.
verification: For each AI MCQ, grep the option text of the answer-key-designated letter in AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html and confirm it equals the answer text listed in AI_Exam_Model_Answer_Key.md.
Diff the option ordering of AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html vs AI_Exam_Question_Paper.md per question to confirm they match.
Confirm label sequences are A,B,C,D (or [A],[B],[C],[D]) in reading order for every AI options block via inspection.
Tally the Q1-Q15 correct-answer letters and confirm the distribution is spread across positions.
Open AI_Exam_Question_Paper.html in a browser (or inspect the DOM) and confirm no structural breakage.
findings:
AI paper shuffled across all three files (HTML, MD, answer key) per audit-map Section 2. Correct-answer TEXT preserved exactly; only positions moved and labels re-lettered sequentially.

MCQ Section A (old -> new letter): Q1 A->C, Q2 B->D, Q3 A->B, Q4 A->A (unchanged), Q5 A->C, Q6 A->B, Q7 A->D, Q8 D->D (unchanged, genuine 'All of the above'), Q9 B->B (unchanged), Q10 A->C. Resulting letters: C,D,B,A,C,B,D,D,B,C.

Fill-in Section B (old -> new letter): Q11 A->C, Q12 A->B, Q13 B->A, Q14 A->D, Q15 A->B. Resulting letters: C,B,A,D,B.

Match Section D: Column B reordered to A=Intelligent-tech, B=Result, C=Input-data, D=Learning-patterns. Semantic pairs intact -> answer code AI(1)->A, Input(2)->C, MachineLearning(3)->D, Output(4)->B (old code was 1->C,2->A,3->B,4->D). New code A,C,D,B is not the straight-line 1->A,2->B,3->C,4->D.

Distribution of Q1-Q15 correct letters: A x2, B x5, C x4, D x4 (MCQ: A1/B3/C3/D3; fill-in: A1/B2/C1/D1). Spread across all four positions, no trivially guessable repeating pattern.

Q30(i) application single-answer MCQ left unchanged (correct stays A) because audit-map Section 2 planned no move for it; noted per FEAT-002 step 7.

Verification: HTML MCQ correct-answer letters (C,D,B,A,C,B,D,D,B,C) == MD == answer key. HTML/MD fill-in option orders identical. Match Column B ordering identical between HTML, MD, and answer key. All 16 option blocks (10 MCQ + 5 fill-in + Q30(i)) have sequential A/B/C/D labels with no gaps or duplicates. HTML parsed cleanly via python html.parser.
